verdict.rationale: Granola documents a one-time Google Calendar or Outlook connection that shows upcoming meetings. Recording, however, starts when the user clicks a meeting notification, not automatically. Nothing in the evidence shows rules that decide which meeting types get captured; per-call-type templates control note formatting, which is an adjacent feature and not a capture rule.

support.subject: As a product manager, I connect Google or Outlook calendar once and control per-meeting-type rules for which meetings get captured automatically
